title: Lomo saltado (beef with tomatoes, onions and oven potatoes)
steps: Preheat the oven to 220 °C. Cut the potatoes into chips, toss with 1 tsp oil and salt and bake for 25 minutes until crisp.
Cut the beef into strips and season with garlic and cumin; cut the onion into wedges and the tomatoes into eighths.
Sear the beef in the remaining oil in a very hot wok for 2 minutes, add the onion and ají paste and fry for 2 more minutes.
Add the tomatoes, soy sauce and vinegar and toss for just 1 minute so the tomatoes keep their shape.
Sprinkle with coriander and serve with the oven potatoes.
